title: Integrated network pharmacology, transcriptomics, and molecular simulations reveal polydatin protects against aortic dissection associated with PPARγ/Nrf2-related antioxidant signaling.
snippet: Aortic dissection (AD) is a life-threatening vascular disease characterized by medial degeneration, extracellular matrix (ECM) destruction, inflammation, and oxidative stress. Polydatin (PD), a natural stilbene glucoside, has cardiovascular protective potential, but its mechanism against AD remains unclear. This study investigated the therapeutic mechanism....
